title: Dune Raiders
tagline: Blast the scorpions, grab the gold, and run for the sun gate.
pitch: Dune Raiders: a desert top-down treasure hunt. Play a little robot explorer roaming a sun-baked desert ruin, blasting scorpion turrets and sand slimes, collecting ancient gold relics, and escaping through the glowing sun gate. Warm sand colours, long shadows, punchy blaster hits.

plan.title: Dune Raiders
plan.tagline: Blast the scorpions, grab the gold, and run for the sun gate.
plan.core_loop: Steer the robot through the sun-baked canyon, blast scorpion turrets and sand slimes, and grab gold relics — once the target is hit the sun gate opens and you dash for it.
plan.win_condition: Collect 20 of 24 gold relics to open the sun gate, then reach the gate.
plan.lose_condition: Lose all 3 lives to turret fire or slime contact.
plan.art_direction: Warm ochre, terracotta and bone-white palette with gold reserved for relics and the sun gate. A low late-afternoon sun rakes long shadows across the packed-dirt canyon floor; stylized toon shading with soft ink outlines, matte sandstone, and a faint heat-haze fog. Mood: sun-baked adventure — Chibi-Robo meets stylized Tomb Raider, punchy and readable.
concept_shots: The little brass robot stands on the packed-dirt canyon floor, blaster raised, as a scorpion turret's glowing red eye aims from behind a ruin arch — long shadows stretch across the sand.
A cluster of spinning gold relics glows in a sunbeam between hoodoos while a sand slime oozes toward the player, dust kicking up.
The massive sun gate blazes gold at the canyon's end, a ring of light rippling out as the robot dashes through it, sparks trailing.

assets.music: Dune-funk desert adventure loop: warm, adventurous, faintly mysterious; plucked oud, frame drum, soft synth pad, mid-tempo 108 BPM groove

sfx.prompt: Bright gold chime with a shimmering two-note arpeggio, relic pickup
Short gritty blaster hit with a metallic robot wince, crunchy and punchy

Triumphant dune-drum fanfare with a shimmering sun-gate chord
Low desolate drone with a gust of wind sweeping across sand

features: Scorpion turrets (spawnEnemy 'turret') guard relic clusters; sand slimes ('patrol') wander the canyon floor
Topdown blaster juice: muzzle spark burst on fire, hit-flash + poof on enemy kills (FX.burst, FX.hitFlash, FX.poof)
Relic pickup juice: sparkle + floating '+1' text with a gold chime (FX.sparkle, FX.text, Audio)
Sun gate stays dark until the relic target is met, then a ring shockwave + banner 'THE SUN GATE OPENS' (FX.ring, UI.banner)
Long shadows: low warm sun via Look overrides (uSunDir) for the sun-baked late-afternoon feel
Ancient ruin cover: scattered World.prop 'ruins' and 'pillar' props to break turret sightlines
plan.mapping_notes: Top-down treasure hunt → player_type 'topdown' + camera 'topdown': the kit's topdown controller ships with a blaster weapon, matching 'blasting' exactly. Desert ruin → 'canyon' level (the only desert setting) with the 'desert' look; the 'ruin' fantasy is carried by scattered 'ruins'/'pillar' props plus the scorpion-totem prop. Scorpion turrets → 'turret' enemies (closest to fixed scorpion guns); sand slimes → 'patrol' enemies. Ancient gold relics → 'coin' collectible (the gold look) labeled 'Relics'. Glowing sun gate → the level's goal portal, gold-styled; collect mode opens it once the target is met. No kart/boat in the pitch, so race laps 0 and no timer (0 = no time limit).

result.summary: Dune Raiders: a desert top-down treasure hunt. The brass robot explores a sun-baked red-rock canyon (canyon level, medium, desert look), blasts scorpion turrets and sand slimes with a gold blaster, collects 20 of 24 gold relics to open the sun gate, and dashes through it. 3 lives, 8 enemies, arcade HUD with relic counter, hearts, minimap and objective line. Built on the scaffold: kept the generated sky, props/splats, HUD, title and rules, and tuned everything to the plan.
changes: Look: desert look with low late-afternoon sun (elevation 14, warm intensity 2.6) for long shadows, plus faint heat-haze fog
Level: canyon medium with 24 collectibles (fixed seed 7); added scattered ruins/pillar/arch props beside the route as ruin cover to break turret sightlines
Player: topdown robot with backpack, brass body / rust accent, gold blaster bolts
Rules: collect 20 of 24 'Relics' (coin tag) to unlock the goal, 3 lives, 8 enemies (turrets + patrol slimes along the route)
HUD: arcade style with relic counter, lives, minimap and objective 'Grab 20 relics to open the sun gate'
Title screen: sells the fantasy with a punchy subtitle

Juice: '+1' gold text on relic pickup, 'THE SUN GATE OPENS' banner + gold ring shockwave + starburst when the target is met, confetti on win, screen shake on player death (on top of FX.auto/Audio.auto)
known_issues: Autopilot collects slowly (only ~3 relics in 25 s) — it follows the route and is not stuck, but reaching 20 relics in a test run takes a long time; the goal-open/win FX were verified by event wiring rather than a full playthrough

post_stages.stage: re-recorded and re-scored after the final kit update
